mapper.sql: SELECT m.id, m.software_name, m.publisher, m.license_type, m.purchased_count, m.note, m.created_at, m.updated_at, COUNT(s.id) AS installed_count FROM software_master m LEFT JOIN pc_software_info s ON s.software_name = m.software_name

sql.if: HAVING m.software_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{req.keyword}, '%') OR m.publisher LIKE CONCAT('%', #{req.keyword}, '%')

mapper.insert: INSERT INTO software_master (software_name, publisher, license_type, purchased_count, note) VALUES (#{softwareName}, #{publisher}, #{licenseType}, #{purchasedCount}, #{note})
mapper.update: UPDATE software_master SET software_name = #{softwareName}, publisher = #{publisher}, license_type = #{licenseType}, purchased_count = #{purchasedCount}, note = #{note}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ( SELECT m.id FROM software_master m JOIN pc_software_info s ON s.software_name = m.software_name WHERE m.purchased_count > 0 GROUP BY m.id HAVING COUNT(s.id) > m.purchased_count ) sub
